projectDescription: An AI-powered medical diagnosis assistant that predicts conditions from user-reported symptoms using a trained XGBoost model via a FastAPI backend and React frontend.
keyFeatures: AI-driven symptom-to-diagnosis prediction using XGBoost classifier
TF-IDF vectorization of free-text symptom descriptions
FastAPI REST backend with CORS support for flexible deployment
React + TypeScript frontend with Tailwind CSS and dark mode
Local diagnosis history with repeat and export capabilities
Support for 20 medical conditions trained on a curated Portuguese-language dataset
Configurable API base URL via environment variable (VITE_API_BASE_URL)
Medical disclaimer to clarify non-clinical usage
publicApiSurface: GET / — Welcome message and API health check
GET /predict/?sintomas={string} — Predict diagnosis from comma-separated symptom string
DiagnosticoIA.predict_simples(sintomas: list | str) — Core prediction method
treinar_modelo() — Train XGBoost model on symptom dataset
acuracia_modelo() — Evaluate model accuracy on test split
salvar_modelo() — Persist trained model to model/modelo_HealthIA.json
salvar_vetorizador() — Persist TF-IDF vectorizer to model/vetorizador_HealthIA.pkl
salvar_encoderY() — Persist label encoder to model/encoderY_HealthIA.pkl
api.predictSymptoms(symptoms: string[]) — Frontend API call for prediction
api.getWelcome() — Frontend API call for health check
